The Toyota Sequoia family

3 generations and variants in the Index, 2001–present. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 2001–2007

    Toyota Sequoia (XK30)

    The first Sequoia, 2001–2007: a Tundra-based full-size SUV, bigger than a Chevrolet Tahoe in most dimensions, with a 240-hp V8.

    240 hp9.1 sec 0-60377,359 built
  2. 2008–2022

    Toyota Sequoia (XK60)

    Toyota's V8 family hauler, built in Princeton, Indiana, with 4-wheel independent suspension and 120.1 cu ft of cargo space behind the front seats, about 38% more than the hybrid that replaced it.

    381 hp7.0 sec 0-60192,365 built
  3. 2023–present

    Toyota Sequoia (XK80)

    The all-new hybrid Sequoia, built in San Antonio on the Tundra's TNGA-F frame, with 437 hp, 583 lb-ft and a 4,318-kg (9,520-lb) tow rating. It's far quicker and thriftier than the V8, but its cargo space is much smaller.

    437 hp5.6 sec 0-6098,198 built
